Name: Hats On Turtles
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
You can put hats on cats and hats on dogs now with the 1.6 update, but your turtles deserve hats too!

[u][size=4]How to Install
[/size][/u][list]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download + unzip Content Patcher and place into Mods folder
[*]Download + unzip Hats on Pets Plus and place into Mods folder
[*]Download + unzip this mod and place into Mods folder
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
Placing hats on turtles works just like putting hats on cats and dogs—hold a hat in your hand, and click on a turtle. To remove the hat, hold another hat and do the same thing. 

Thanks to Syma for making Hats on Pets Plus!
